limitations: Short conditional multi-group projection using a frozen numeric producer; no full FFN/decode, DRAM fill, encoder/RNG generation, target-process STA, physical PPA or model/PPL validation.
Cycle/event agreement is separately recorded execution evidence from one shared kernel, not independent physical hardware validation.
Listed local state is a partial allocation inventory, not complete hardware area or storage; wider ports and additional lanes have uncharacterized physical costs.
Three seeds provide numerical and identity coverage, not measured latency variation or a performance confidence interval.
The 205.75 us decomposition is specific to the exclusive endpoint and credit/clock semantics, not an architecture-independent lower bound.
Issue116 commit availability was checked against the saved HTTP422 freeze snapshot only; this reviewer made no network or publication verification.
